services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Educating, inspiring, and empowering people everywhere through the legacy of President James Monroe. All tour groups must give notice forty-eight (48) hours prior to their scheduled tour for cancellation in order to receive a full refund. Any cancellations within forty-eight (48) hours of the tour will not be refunded. Mastercard, Visa, and Discover, Cash upon Arrival, Checks can be made out to “James Monroe Museum” There is street parking available at your convenience.
